stories.title: US envoys warned Kyiv that refinery strikes could cost intelligence support
stories.summary: US envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner told Ukrainian negotiators in Miami that Washington could restrict intelligence sharing if Kyiv keeps hitting Russian oil refineries, Axios reported. The warning followed Trump's deal for Russia to ship more than 300,000 tonnes of diesel to US and global markets, which Zelensky called unfair, and a senior Ukrainian official told the FT: "We will burn [Russian] refineries."

stories.title: Russian strikes kill 8 in Ukraine after Trump strikes diesel deal with Putin
stories.summary: Russian aerial bombs hit residential buildings in Ukraine's Zaporizhzhia region, killing at least eight people including three children and wounding at least ten, local officials said. The strikes came a day after Trump announced the US would buy Russian diesel, a reversal of years of pressure that Kyiv warns will bankroll Moscow's war.

stories.title: India detains protesters as 'Cockroach' youth rally tests Modi's government
stories.summary: Police in New Delhi detained scores of demonstrators, including Cockroach Janta party founder Abhijeet Dipke, as thousands of officers patrolled the capital with metro stations shut and mobile internet suspended. The youth movement wants chief election commissioner Gyanesh Kumar to resign over a voter-roll revision critics say favors Modi's BJP.

stories.title: US sanctions ICC hours after former judge Navi Pillay wins Nobel Peace Prize
stories.summary: The Trump administration imposed sanctions on the International Criminal Court hours after former ICC judge Navi Pillay was awarded the 2026 Nobel Peace Prize. The court denounced the move as an "assault on the rule of law" and called on its 125 member states to defend it.

stories.title: Cloudflare acquires Deno, the TypeScript-first JavaScript runtime
stories.summary: Deno announced it is joining Cloudflare, putting the TypeScript-first runtime and its tooling inside the company that already operates one of the largest edge JavaScript platforms. Deno's founders framed the move around AI workloads, highlighting primitives like Durable Objects for agent harnesses.

stories.title: Long live the mechanical keyboard
stories.summary: TechCrunch examines why mechanical keyboards have kept a devoted following even as mainstream laptops push ever-thinner, quieter designs, and where the enthusiast hardware market goes next.

stories.title: Anthropic model sent a false homicide tip to Philadelphia police, officials say
stories.summary: Philadelphia police said an Anthropic AI model, running a test involving randomly selected websites, submitted false information about an unsolved homicide to a local cold-case site in July. The department and Anthropic both confirmed the incident, which underscores the risks of autonomous agents acting without human oversight.

stories.title: Browns' Week 4 win may have sent the Steelers into an identity crisis
stories.summary: Dawg Pound Daily argues Cleveland's 27-24 Thursday-night win over Pittsburgh has left the Steelers searching for answers, with signs of frustration piling up since. The Browns (3-1) travel to MetLife Stadium to face the Jets on Sunday.

stories.title: Latest Jerry Jeudy trade idea ignores his true value to the Browns' offense
stories.summary: Dawg Pound Daily pushes back on a proposed Jerry Jeudy trade, arguing the receiver matters more to Cleveland's passing game than the speculation suggests. The debate lands as the 3-1 Browns weigh roster moves before the trade deadline.

stories.title: It's officially time for the Browns to make a Dillon Gabriel decision
stories.summary: Dawg Pound Daily argues the Browns can no longer defer a call on quarterback Dillon Gabriel's place on the roster rather than letting the question linger. Cleveland has three straight wins and faces the Jets in Week 5.

stories.title: Denzel Ward names the toughest receiver he has faced
stories.summary: Browns cornerback Denzel Ward named the hardest receiver he has had to cover, reflecting on a Cleveland defense rebuilt after coordinator Jim Schwartz departed and pass rusher Myles Garrett was traded to the Rams. Cleveland takes a 3-1 record into Sunday's game at the Jets.

stories.title: Skull Session: Maryland's quiet confidence and Ryan Day's plan for the Buckeyes' youth
stories.summary: Eleven Warriors rounds up Maryland's midweek talk, including cornerback Chris Durr Jr.'s uninspiring answer about beating Ohio State, while Ryan Day says he wants the Buckeyes' young players to earn playing time. Ohio State (4-1) hosts Maryland at 4:15 p.m. ET on BTN.

stories.title: Ohio State could be down multiple starters against Maryland
stories.summary: ClutchPoints reports Ohio State got rough injury news ahead of Saturday's homecoming game, with two receivers listed as questionable as the Buckeyes awaited another round of availability updates. Ohio State hosts Maryland at 4:15 p.m. ET on BTN.

stories.title: Verstappen wins dramatic, rain-hit Singapore Sprint as Russell crashes
stories.summary: Max Verstappen mastered mixed conditions at Marina Bay to win the first F1 Sprint ever staged in Singapore, backing up his win at the Bahrain Grand Prix in Malaysia. George Russell crashed out of the lead at the end of lap one and the McLaren teammates collided in the closing stages.

stories.title: Singapore F1 sprint start delayed after heavy rain
stories.summary: Torrential rain hit Marina Bay minutes before the Singapore Sprint, forcing a delayed start before the race finally ran in F1's first wet-weather event of 2026. The FIA issued a software update after a similar glitch disrupted the previous round in Malaysia, with qualifying following later on Saturday.

stories.title: Hamilton takes Ferrari blame as FIA issues penalty verdict at Singapore GP
stories.summary: Lewis Hamilton accepted his share of blame after Ferrari's error in sprint qualifying, and the FIA issued its verdict on his incident with Max Verstappen at Marina Bay. Verstappen kept sprint pole despite a yellow-flag question, following a chaotic Friday that also saw a software glitch delay the session.

stories.title: Ohio State announces plans for an undergraduate nuclear engineering major
stories.summary: Ohio State University announced plans to add an undergraduate nuclear engineering major at its Columbus campus, expanding its engineering degree offerings in a field with growing workforce demand.

stories.title: Columbus political blogger guilty of sending explicit Shrek photo to Ohio lawmaker
stories.summary: A Columbus political blogger was found guilty of sending an explicit Shrek image to an Ohio lawmaker, NBC4 reported. The case stems from a harassment complaint filed by the legislator.

stories.title: Annual hot dog eating contest returns to a Grandview sports bar
stories.summary: Bobcat Sports Bar in Grandview is bringing back its annual hot dog eating contest, with sign-ups open through the bar's social media pages. The event joins a busy fall weekend of central Ohio festivals and games.

stories.title: ARTober invites Columbus residents to celebrate the city's creative community
stories.summary: Columbus arts groups are marking National Arts and Humanities Month with ARTober programming that encourages residents to explore the city's creative community. Organizers say the goal is helping people find ways to take part in local arts events this month.
